title: Retail spice price (dollars per gram)

source.name: Saffron and common-spice retail pricing
source.publisher: industry pricing guides (e.g. Raihan Saffron, LatestCost) cross-checked against typical US grocery pricing

notes: Genuine, lab-graded saffron retails for roughly $10-30/gram in the US in 2026 (midpoint $15 used here). Black pepper retail price is a conservative round estimate from typical US grocery pricing (~$0.02/gram).
